name: The Mechanar
shortDescription: The Mechanar, a named setting in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: Tempest Keep dungeon where Pathaleon the Calculator holds one Arcatraz key shard. Its story art is interpretive; no exact map coordinate, dungeon floor plan or travel route is asserted. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
